payload.title: Anchor demand stops at ANCHOR_PROMOTION_MIN_JUDGMENTS=5 anchors per tool (false-positive anchors count), so a unanimous true_positive pair then gets no third seat and finding_promotion skips it as not_ground_truth
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:257-266 (ANCHOR_PROMOTION_MIN_JUDGMENTS = 5, written as the adapter-readiness cost bound)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1177-1188 (demand = the shortfall to 5 anchors, counted over all anchor groups of the tool)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1139-1146 (a true_positive pair is a candidate only while remaining demand is above zero; a false_positive pair is unconditional)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_promotion.py:199-206 (a consensus row that is not ground truth, which a 2-judge pair is, is skipped as not_ground_truth)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:331-344 (ground truth needs ANCHOR_MIN_JUDGE_COUNT agreeing seats with no dissent)
aria-kernel/tests/test_jj1_anchor_consensus.py:416-423 (the test pins that a true_positive pair costs nothing once demand is met)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per rule: the JJ-2 cost bound written for adapter readiness now throttles the F2.3 acceptance bar added later, which accepts only anchors; a test pins the throttle.
payload.notes: Once a tool holds five anchors, demand is zero and a new unanimous true_positive pair is never put to the arbiter, so it can never reach is_ground_truth_row and never promotes. The live-store note of ARIA-MEDIUM-713 (10-18) shows 16 anchors skewed 11 false_positive to 5 true_positive, so false-positive anchors alone can zero the demand for a tool while its true positives wait forever. This is masked today by the sha starvation above and appears as soon as that is fixed. Close condition: Demand an arbiter for every unanimous true_positive pair whose fingerprint is neither promoted nor settled, bounded per cycle by a new judgment_pipeline policy key and the discretionary admission door, instead of the five-anchor shortfall. Test: a tool holding five false_positive anchors still gets an arbiter for a new true_positive pair (red today); replace test_true_positive_pair_costs_nothing_once_demand_is_met with a test of the new bound. Plan row: F0.7 and the J-series follow-up (not scheduled). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
